reason: We already have fresh dabba chutney made by our cook at home, and for spontaneous late-night snacks I rely on standard bottles already in the pantry rather than ordering new tubes online.
objection: My cook already makes fresh green chutney in a dabba for free, so paying ₹179 online is hard to justify.
would_change_my_mind: Specialized spicy street-style momo sauces or dips that a home cook cannot replicate, available on quick-commerce.
